directives.treatmentMonitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline - generational IPC and power/performance/area. Deliverable: baseline architecture report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking - design-space metrics measured per milestone. Target: define chiplet roadmap. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review - compare against competitor node cadence. Target: 50% of roadmap. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation - architecture trending toward performance target. Escalate if roadmap slips >2 quarters. ANNUAL REVIEW: Comprehensive roadmap audit.

If a design produces thermal or yield regressions, pause and request specialist review within 7 days.

Design a shared semantic layer and governed ontology linking sources
Embed analytics directly into operational workflows with feedback monitoring
Instrument model-drift detection and retraining triggers
Review analytics adoption and decision quality quarterly against operational KPIs

directives.treatmentLabel: Implement Semiconductor Equipment Capacity & Metrology Governance Structure
directives.treatmentDescription: Implement a fab-equipment investment and process-control program scaling lithography and packaging capacity while closing metrology gaps that allow yield-killing defects to escape.
treatmentSteps: Assess tool throughput, uptime, and leading-edge lithography capacity constraints
Plan High-NA EUV and advanced-packaging capacity against demand roadmap
Deploy in-line electron-beam and optical metrology with statistical process control
Tighten defect-feedback loops between metrology, etch, and deposition steps
Review fab power stability as a cross-domain dependency with the energy domain quarterly

directives.treatmentMonitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline - tool throughput, uptime, and defect-escape rate. Deliverable: baseline equipment report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking - metrology coverage measured monthly. Target: close priority gaps. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review - compare yield against node benchmark. Target: 50% of yield goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation - leading-edge capacity trending to plan. Escalate if EUV bottleneck persists. ANNUAL REVIEW: Comprehensive fab-equipment audit.
directives.treatmentEscalation: If fab output or yield shows no measurable improvement after 30 days, or if a lithography or metrology bottleneck constrains leading-edge supply for >7 consecutive days, escalate to a fab operations director for root cause analysis and intervention redesign.
